mapper.select: SELECT id, name, phone, email, avatar, address FROM customers WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT CAST(user_id AS CHAR) as id, nick_name as name, phonenumber as phone, avatar FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0' AND status = '0'

SELECT p.id, p.name, c.name as customerName, p.address, p.area, p.status, p.progress as progressPercent, pm.role as myRole, p.updated_at as lastUpdateTime FROM project_members pm INNER JOIN projects p ON pm.project_id = p.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN customers c ON p.customer_id = c.id WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.is_active = 1 ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC

SELECT id, project_id as projectId, stage, stage_order as stageOrder, plan_start_date as planStartDate, plan_end_date as planEndDate, actual_start_date as actualStartDate, actual_end_date as actualEndDate, status, completion_rate as completionRate, description FROM project_schedules WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY stage_order ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, project_id as projectId, stage, stage_order as stageOrder, plan_start_date as planStartDate, plan_end_date as planEndDate, actual_start_date as actualStartDate, actual_end_date as actualEndDate, status, completion_rate as completionRate, description FROM project_schedules WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY stage_order ASC

SELECT qi.id, qi.project_id, qi.schedule_id, qi.inspection_type, qi.title, qi.description, qi.result, qi.inspection_date, qi.images, qi.remarks, qi.created_at, qis.id as issue_id, qis.title as issue_title, qis.description as issue_description, qis.category as issue_category, qis.location as issue_location, qis.images as issue_images, qis.status as issue_status, qis.due_date as issue_due_date, qis.resolved_at as issue_resolved_at, qis.created_at as issue_created_at FROM quality_inspections qi LEFT JOIN quality_issues qis ON qi.id = qis.quality_inspection_id WHERE qi.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY qi.inspection_date DESC, qi.created_at DESC

SELECT id, original_name as originalName, path, url, size, type, category, created_at as createdAt FROM file_uploads WHERE category = #{projectId} AND type = 'DESIGN' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quality_issues WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pm.project_id) FROM project_members pm INNER JOIN projects p ON pm.project_id = p.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.is_active = 1 AND p.status IN ('DESIGN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'CONSTRUCTION')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quality_issues qi INNER JOIN project_members pm ON qi.project_id = pm.project_id WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.is_active = 1 AND qi.status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_schedules ps INNER JOIN project_members pm ON ps.project_id = pm.project_id WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.is_active = 1 AND ps.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND DATE(ps.plan_end_date) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM project_members WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND is_active = 1
SELECT dict_label FROM sys_dict_data WHERE dict_type = #{dictType} AND dict_value = #{dictValue} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.address, p.area, p.status, p.status as statusText, p.end_date as endDate, p.progress as progressPercent FROM projects p WHERE p.customer_id = #{customerId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.name, c.name as customerName, p.address, p.area, p.status, p.status as statusText, p.progress as progressPercent, pm.role as myRole, p.updated_at as lastUpdateTime FROM project_members pm INNER JOIN projects p ON pm.project_id = p.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN customers c ON p.customer_id = c.id WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.is_active = 1 ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC

SELECT id, room_name as roomName, room_type as roomType, area, description, floor, orientation, file_ids as fileIds, sort_order as sortOrder FROM project_rooms WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC
